Cabela's Big Game Hunter - Pro Hunts.summary: Hunt with the pros! Bring home bigger game faster using advice from our pros, including Wade Middleton, Jim Shockey, and Ralph & Vicki Cianciarulo. Traverse maps 4x the size of any previous Cabela's Big Game Hunter game! Track, scout and target your trophy animal in all new ways!
